easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Deceptive Frostkite.
description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Deceptive Frostkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Deceptive Frostkite. Choose to have Deceptive Frostkite enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
